resources.string: About ZeePlay
Checking ADB access… If the car asks, allow ZeePlay and tick “Always allow”.
ADB is enabled, but this ZeePlay test app is not authorized yet.
ZeePlay is not approved yet. Tap Check ADB access, then allow ZeePlay on the car screen.
This head unit offers only wireless debugging with pairing, which ZeePlay does not support yet.
Allow Nearby devices for ZeePlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
Allow Nearby devices so ZeePlay can connect to your paired iPhone.
Allow precise Location for ZeePlay in the head unit’s app permissions.
ZeePlay

Starts the saved car hotspot when ZeePlay opens. Turning this on automatically requests the required permissions through ADB; allow the prompt on the car screen. Enable “Open after the car starts” for boot startup. Keeps the hotspot name and password and never turns it off.
Back to ZeePlay
This file is not a ZeePlay settings backup.
Show a QR code so a phone browser on the same network can export or import ZeePlay settings. The service stops when you leave the page.

Some firmwares block third-party boot receivers. This asks the head unit, over its own ADB link, to exempt ZeePlay from background limits so the boot broadcast can reach it. One-time; re-run after a firmware update.

ZeePlay tells the iPhone the car\'s charge and range, so Apple Maps can warn about a low charge and suggest chargers on the way. The iPhone is told about an electric car only while ZeePlay can read the battery. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
The car hotspot settings differ from those saved in ZeePlay

While ZeePlay is in the background, the dashboard map also shows as a card on the home screen: BYD home, map home or your default launcher. Tap the card to open CarPlay, drag it to move it, and pinch it to resize it. The dashboard keeps its map. Needs permission to draw over other apps.
Choose where to save your report. If the file picker is unavailable, ZeePlay saves it in the app.\u0020
The iPhone chosen in ZeePlay is no longer paired with the car
ZeePlay Usage Access

Half screen keeps the speed and status readouts the cluster normally shows beside the map; full screen lets the map fill the cluster. ZeePlay sets the shape whenever the CarPlay map appears, which otherwise overrides the shape picked on the car. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.

The card stays hidden until the car’s media stack has been opened. Opening the gate does that, which briefly brings the media screen to the front and then returns to ZeePlay. Leave it off to skip the screen flash. Applies at once.
ZeePlay · waiting for the CarPlay map
Connect when ZeePlay opens
After the car wakes, open ZeePlay and start wireless CarPlay when the selected iPhone connects over Bluetooth. Some head units restrict background launches.
Several devices are paired with the car. Return to ZeePlay, tap Choose iPhone and pick yours, then retry.
Pair the iPhone with the car\'s Bluetooth again, or return to ZeePlay and tap Choose iPhone to pick another one. Then retry.
Make sure the head unit and the iPhone are on the same Wi-Fi network and its name and password match ZeePlay settings, then retry.
Retry the connection. If it fails again, return to ZeePlay and save a report under Settings → Diagnostics.
Check that the car hotspot is on and its name and password match ZeePlay settings. If available, use 5 GHz, then retry.
Allow the requested USB, Nearby devices or Location permissions for ZeePlay on the head unit, then retry.
Could not start CarPlay. Return to ZeePlay and check app permissions.

ZeePlay reads the navi mode you pick on the steering wheel. In Off and Turn on by navi the dashboard shows arrows only, so the iPhone does not send the map; in Small and Full screen navi it does, within a second or two of the switch. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
Use the default connection mode and selected iPhone when ZeePlay opens. Manual connection buttons use the mode you choose.
Your report was saved privately in ZeePlay because a public save location was unavailable. Share it or view it here. Nothing is sent automatically.
ZeePlay

Connect the car and iPhone to the same external Wi-Fi in system settings. Enter its exact name and WPA2 password below; leave the password empty only for an open network. Use WPA2 or WPA2/WPA3 mixed mode and disable client isolation on the router. ZeePlay keeps this Wi-Fi connection and creates no hotspot.
Hide the selected system bar in ZeePlay and CarPlay.
The hotspot interface saved in ZeePlay does not exist on this car
Hotspot must be confirmed off. Disconnect clients and turn it off in car settings, then retry. ZeePlay will not restart it automatically.
The tested information is already present. No duplicate added; ZeePlay has no rollback ownership of an existing element.

Use the car’s hotspot for the smoothest wireless CarPlay. You do not need to join it manually on your iPhone; ZeePlay sends the hotspot details over Bluetooth. Select 5 GHz in car settings if available.
In CarPlay, swipe down with three fingers to open ZeePlay settings.

Launchers that support ZeePlay can show the live dashboard map inside their own home screen. Off by default, because any app on the head unit could then ask for the map. See docs/LAUNCHER_INTEGRATION.md.
Make ZeePlay feel right for your car.
ZeePlay connects through the car hotspot “%1$s”. Turn it on in the car settings, then connect.

Optional: keep the stock map off the cluster while ZeePlay projects there. Off leaves it alone. Component mode hides its cluster projection; package mode disables the whole stock map until projection stops. Requires authorized local ADB. Changes apply after reconnecting.
On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth and pair with the car. Then return to ZeePlay and choose Connect phone.

Does the same while another app, such as WhatsApp, Telegram or Zoom, is in a voice or video call. Voice notes and plain recordings are left alone because the car mutes the plain microphone in this state. Needs ZeePlay running, so this also turns on the wheel-key accessibility service. Off by default.

Holds a Telecom call during CarPlay calls so the car switches to its phone audio state and its own echo cancellation works. ZeePlay’s echo canceller stays out of those calls. Your voice can come out louder or distorted. Off by default; applies at the next call.

Receiver based on xcertplay, licensed under GPL-3.0. ZeePlay’s interface follows DiAuto’s design, licensed under AGPL-3.0.

Includes AndroidX, Bouncy Castle, JmDNS and SLF4J. Source and license notices accompany this release.

CarPlay and the CarPlay icon belong to Apple Inc. ZeePlay is an independent project.
Request ZeePlay ADB authorization
Return from car settings to ZeePlay, then connect. Accept the CarPlay prompt on your iPhone. A car internet plan is not required; mobile data availability depends on your phone’s network settings.

1. Open car hotspot settings, turn the hotspot on and select 5 GHz if available.\n2. Copy its name and password below exactly.\n3. Leave the car hotspot on when connecting. ZeePlay sends the details over Bluetooth; your iPhone joins automatically.
No music for 15 seconds: the lamps go back to the car’s own settings, and ZeePlay takes over again when music starts.

While CarPlay music plays, the car\'s own ambient-light music rhythm runs, with the colours and effects set in the car\'s ambient-light menu, where its music rhythm must be on. ZeePlay does not set the lamps itself meanwhile. Checked when switched on. Needs the car\'s network ADB only where the head unit does not let ZeePlay start the rhythm itself.
The car\'s music rhythm is not available: ZeePlay cannot start it itself, and ZeePlay\'s network ADB access or the head unit\'s audio service call is missing. Nothing was saved.

Turns on the saved car hotspot when ZeePlay opens and before a wireless connection. ZeePlay needs Android\'s “Modify system settings” access; ADB is not required. To have the hotspot after a full restart, also turn on opening ZeePlay after the car starts. The hotspot is not turned off automatically.

Uses the car\'s hotspot service when ZeePlay opens or returns, and before a wireless connection. This service does not require ADB or Modify system settings access. Support depends on the car firmware. The hotspot is not turned off automatically.
Once a day, ZeePlay checks GitHub for a new version and shows it on the home screen. It never downloads without your tap.

ZeePlay offers the iPhone no CarPlay audio, so music, navigation and calls should go over the iPhone\'s Bluetooth connection with the car. Keep the iPhone paired with the car and choose Bluetooth as the car\'s audio source. If the sound plays on the iPhone instead, turn this off. Reconnects CarPlay.

Nothing to type: the car hotspot settings are imported; when the car has none, ZeePlay writes its own details there after your confirmation, and devices using this hotspot may have to reconnect. Needs ADB on Android 11 and newer; not available on Android 8 to 10.
Nothing could be read from the car and ZeePlay has no hotspot details yet. Continuing creates a new hotspot name and password in the car; other devices have to enter the new password.

The car\'s saved hotspot configuration could not be read. Continuing overwrites it with the ZeePlay hotspot details: the hotspot name may change, the password is replaced, and other connected devices have to re-enter the password.
ZeePlay\'s hotspot password is written to the car\'s hotspot settings. Devices using this hotspot may have to re-enter the password.
ZeePlay could not write the car hotspot settings. The name and password stay unchanged.
An open hotspot in ZeePlay does not overwrite the car\'s password.
The car hotspot now uses the ZeePlay password.

For launchers that show ZeePlay in a card or picture-in-picture window, such as BYD\'s DiYou desktop. CarPlay opens in ZeePlay\'s own window, as in 0.2.11 and earlier, instead of a separate full-screen one. Applies the next time CarPlay opens, without disconnecting.
ZeePlay is starting CarPlay with your iPhone.

Sends the CarPlay picture straight to the head unit\'s compositor instead of drawing it inside the ZeePlay window. Can lower the delay by about one screen refresh. Picture adjustments do not apply. Reconnects CarPlay.

Stops ZeePlay from requesting media audio focus while CarPlay music is active. Enable this if your head unit routes its physical volume buttons to ZeePlay and they no longer adjust volume. Steering-wheel play, pause and track controls may stop working on head units that require focus. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.
Hide the status and navigation bars in ZeePlay and CarPlay.
Size of text and controls on ZeePlay\'s own screens. Automatic enlarges them on large screens with a low density. CarPlay is not affected.
Choose a language for ZeePlay

Shows the ZeePlay icon as a bubble over the head unit\'s home screen: tap it to come back to CarPlay and drag it anywhere. It hides as soon as a ZeePlay screen is open and comes back when you leave. Hold it to lock its place, hold it again to unlock. Needs \"display over other apps\".

Works independently of the Audio focus setting. During each CarPlay navigation prompt, ZeePlay requests temporary audio focus that lets other sound duck, and releases it after the prompt. Try this if prompts are silent until music plays, or if music should get quieter during prompts. The head unit’s own audio may get quieter or pause during prompts. Applies at the next CarPlay connection.

How much charging current ZeePlay offers the iPhone over USB. If wired CarPlay drops every few seconds and the iPhone reconnects by itself, the car\'s USB port may not supply enough power: try Reduced, then Low. The iPhone then charges more slowly. Applies at the next USB connection.

Over Wi-Fi Direct the car searches for Wi-Fi networks every few seconds, and each search makes music and video stutter. With this on, ZeePlay pauses the search while CarPlay runs. The car then also does not join a known network, such as your phone\'s hotspot, by itself until CarPlay ends; you can still join one in the car\'s Wi-Fi settings. Turn it off to let the car join automatically. Applies at the next connection.
“Modify system settings” access is not allowed yet. Allow it so ZeePlay can turn on the hotspot.
ZeePlay couldn’t read the DiLink version. Choose it below, or keep Not sure.
CarPlay authentication could not be loaded. Install the complete ZeePlay build over this app. No uninstall or hotspot change is needed.

CarPlay can move to two thirds of the screen while ZeePlay shows a panel in the rest: on the passenger\'s side of a landscape screen, at the bottom of a portrait one (clock and, where it is read, the battery). Show and hide it from the in-session menu. Applies at the next connection.

When the head unit shows ZeePlay in split screen, CarPlay redraws for that window instead of shrinking with black bars, and back to full screen without reconnecting. The window\'s size is learned the first time, so the picture fits exactly from the next connection. With the dock on Automatic, CarPlay then puts it at the bottom. Applies at the next connection.

Optional: swipe up with the configured settings gesture fingers to show hidden car status/navigation bars for five seconds; swipe down still opens ZeePlay settings. Disable on head units with conflicting gestures. Some firmware may ignore the request.

ZeePlay draws this card on the map. Move it in 2 % steps. The iOS glass card cannot be moved on its own. Changes apply without reconnecting. The custom card stays on for straight-ahead as well as turns.
Usage Access lets ZeePlay follow the instrument theme and map card. Only BYD cluster activity events are processed locally. This car does not provide a working permission settings page.
The car allowed ZeePlay only once. Tap again and tick “Always allow” so background vehicle data can reconnect.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization, and its ADB has not approved ZeePlay, so ZeePlay cannot allow the VPN itself.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization, and ZeePlay cannot use its ADB over network to allow the VPN itself.
This head unit cannot open VPN authorization. Return to ZeePlay to check connection permissions or use wireless.
ZeePlay wheel keys

BYD\'s custom key switches the volume keys between volume and dashboard map zoom while the dashboard shows the CarPlay map. A call always keeps the volume. On some cars the console volume sends the same keys, so it zooms too while zoom is on. Uses ZeePlay\'s wheel key service; the note on the dashboard needs ADB.

Assign any available steering-wheel or keyboard key to toggle CarPlay music playback. Works while CarPlay runs, including in the background if the wheel-key service is enabled. During calls or when disconnected, the vehicle keeps the key. A key reserved by firmware may not reach ZeePlay.

A single press keeps the car\'s action. Press twice within the selected interval; ZeePlay opens Siri after the selected delay. The wheel key service is required if the car\'s assistant takes over the screen. Applies immediately.
Only a long press of the wheel\'s voice button opens Siri. A short press does nothing in ZeePlay.

With Report location to iPhone on, ZeePlay also sends the car\'s wheel speed and gear, so Apple Maps can keep your position moving in tunnels and car parks. Reconnects CarPlay. Needs ADB over network on the head unit.
